name: ATR Trailing Stop with EMA Trend Filter
description: Trend-following strategy using ATR trailing stop + 1H 200 EMA alignment. Long when ATR is bullish AND price > EMA. Short when ATR is bearish AND price < EMA. Goes FLAT (closes position) when ATR conflicts with EMA trend (Idle state).

conditions.description: ATR Long signal (ATR bullish + price > 1H 200 EMA)
ATR Idle - trend conflict, close and stay flat
ATR Short signal (ATR bearish + price < 1H 200 EMA)
ATR Idle - trend conflict, close and stay flat
